name: Roblox High School [Legacy]
desc:
The original Roblox High School is back! Enjoy revisiting the classic game like it was in 2014-2017. Go to class, hang out after school, explore the map, and make brand new friends here!

⚠️ FOLLOW THE RULES ⚠️
Anyone caught breaking the rules will be PERMANENTLY BANNED and CANNOT APPEAL.
This is a game for ALL AGES, so please be respectful and act appropriately so the game can be fun for everyone! If you see people severely breaking the rules, please report it to us!

Note that we don't plan on making any other major additions to the game - we want to keep it as close to the original as possible! Enjoy revisiting the past :)
